selection_authority: Explicit user instruction adopting the one-human, model-assisted author-review protocol; this is methodology selection, not launch authorization
author: Mohammed Bangie
matching_policy: Canonical questions already approved in the exact reference release only; whitespace collapse and casefold; no inferred paraphrases or model-generated replies
eligibility_policy: Use the exact author-approved dialogue_relevant and explicit_linked_dependencies boolean labels; never infer labels from predictions
limitations: One author can introduce annotation and scoring bias; model assistance can reproduce correlated errors.
No independent reviewer or authenticated model-review logs are asserted.
Hashes establish integrity and provenance bindings, not semantic truth.
System blinding reduces exposure to system labels but cannot establish independence or remove recognizable output-style bias.
Simulated replies cover annotated scenarios, not observed human conversations.
One seed cannot estimate between-seed variability.
